reasoning_content:
Interesting — `index.html` currently contains `<script type="module" src="src/application/index.tsx">` (not converted to iife — meaning the `transformIndexHtml` handler only converts during build, so this is the dev server's entry version). Wait, let me re-check: `transformIndexHtml` has `if (ctx.server) return html;` — meaning it skips conversion during dev serve (module script is fine with vite dev), and converts to a regular script during build. The current index.html contains the module script → this is consistent with the last run of the dev server having written it... Actually, `generateAppWrapper` writes index.html on each serve/build run. In the dev run (npm start), the module script src is written, and it's left as-is because transformIndexHtml skips in the server context. So index.html is currently in a state written by the dev server. No problem.

So, index.html currently contains the wrapper + module script injection. The dev server flow is confirmed as working (the summary claims the server returned 200, but I'll verify it myself).

Next, start the dev server. `mise run start` → depends on generate-app-wrapper (skips the fetch if a snapshot exists), then `npm start` (vite). Port 5173. Launch in the background, then curl.
